indicators.name: CNN Fear & Greed Index
indicators.description: A daily composite index designed by CNN to measure prevailing fear and greed in the U.S. stock market using multiple market-behavior indicators. The index ranges from 0 to 100, with lower values representing greater fear and higher values representing greater greed.
indicators.significance: The Fear & Greed Index provides a behavioral measure of the prevailing emotional conditions in U.S. equity markets. Changes in the index can indicate shifts in market momentum, volatility, demand for safe-haven assets, and willingness to take risk. It can therefore provide context for interpreting market moves alongside prices, volatility measures, credit conditions, and broader financial-market indicators.

indicators.name: Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index
indicators.description: A daily composite index from Alternative.me measuring crypto-market sentiment on a scale from 0 to 100, where lower values represent greater fear and higher values represent greater greed. Alternative.me derives the index from multiple sentiment-related inputs, including Bitcoin volatility, market momentum and volume, social media activity, surveys, Bitcoin dominance, and Google Trends. Alternative.me's published methodology currently identifies the index as Bitcoin-focused.
indicators.significance: The Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index combines multiple market and sentiment signals into a single 0-to-100 measure. Alternative.me's published methodology assigns 25% weight to volatility, 25% to market momentum and volume, 15% to social media, 15% to surveys, 10% to Bitcoin dominance, and 10% to Google Trends, although Alternative.me currently states that its surveys are paused. The index therefore captures several dimensions of market behavior rather than directly measuring investor sentiment through a single survey. It can be analyzed alongside price trends, volatility, trading volume, derivatives positioning, funding rates, market breadth, Bitcoin dominance, and other sentiment indicators to provide broader context for changes in crypto-market conditions.

indicators.name: CoinMarketCap Crypto Market Metrics
indicators.description: A market-wide daily snapshot from CoinMarketCap containing aggregate cryptocurrency market capitalization, trading volume, market-share measures, sector-level market capitalization and volume, derivatives activity, market growth rates, and ecosystem activity statistics. The dataset provides a broad view of crypto-market size, liquidity, market structure, capital distribution, and changes in market activity within a single observation.
indicators.significance: CoinMarketCap Crypto Market Metrics provides broad market context that can be used to interpret changes across individual crypto assets and specialized indicators. Total market capitalization measures the aggregate value of the cryptocurrency market, while 24-hour spot trading volume provides a measure of market activity and liquidity. Altcoin market capitalization and volume help isolate activity outside Bitcoin, while Bitcoin and Ethereum dominance measure their respective shares of the total cryptocurrency market and can provide context for capital distribution and rotation. DeFi market capitalization and volume provide visibility into decentralized-finance activity, while stablecoin market capitalization and volume provide context for the size and activity of crypto-native liquidity instruments. Derivatives volume provides a measure of activity in crypto derivatives markets. The dataset also includes daily percentage changes in total market capitalization, total volume, DeFi activity, stablecoin activity, and derivatives activity, allowing the system to identify rapid changes in market conditions. Active cryptocurrency, market-pair, and exchange counts provide additional context for the size and breadth of the crypto ecosystem. These metrics can be analyzed alongside asset prices, market breadth, volatility, derivatives positioning, funding rates, stablecoin indicators, Bitcoin dominance, DeFi indicators, and macroeconomic conditions to identify changes in liquidity, market participation, capital rotation, and broader crypto-market regimes.

indicators.name: IG WTI Crude Oil Retail Positioning
indicators.description: A daily measure of long and short positioning among retail traders on the IG trading platform for WTI crude oil. The indicator reports the percentage of IG retail traders holding long and short positions and the resulting net positioning. This data represents IG's own retail trader pool and is not a market-wide measure of all retail traders or investors.
indicators.significance: IG WTI crude oil retail positioning provides a daily view of directional exposure among retail traders using the IG trading platform. The indicator can provide context for retail sentiment, speculative positioning, and changes in exposure to the crude oil market. Because the dataset represents only IG's retail trader pool rather than the entire retail-investor population, it should be interpreted as a broker-specific positioning signal rather than a comprehensive measure of overall retail sentiment. WTI positioning can be analyzed alongside crude oil supply and demand, OPEC policy, oil inventories, global economic growth, inflation, the U.S. dollar, interest rates, and the Brent-WTI relationship to provide additional context for energy-market conditions.

indicators.name: CFTC 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note Futures Positioning
indicators.description: A weekly measure of 10-Year U.S. Treasury Note futures open interest and trader positioning reported by the CFTC's Traders in Financial Futures report. The data separates Treasury futures positions into Dealer/Intermediary, Asset Manager/Institutional, Leveraged Funds, Other Reportables, and Nonreportables, with long, short, spreading, and net exposure measures where applicable.
indicators.significance: CFTC 10-Year Treasury futures positioning provides a structured view of market-participant exposure to the intermediate-to-longer portion of the U.S. Treasury market. Changes in open interest reveal changes in futures-market participation, while changes in long and short positions show how different trader groups are adjusting exposure to 10-Year Treasury futures. The 10-Year Treasury market is closely connected to expectations for monetary policy, inflation, economic growth, and the broader supply and demand for government debt, making positioning useful context for Treasury yields, duration risk, the yield curve, and broader financial conditions.

indicators.name: CFTC U.S. Dollar Index Futures Positioning
indicators.description: A weekly measure of U.S. Dollar Index futures open interest and trader positioning reported by the CFTC's Traders in Financial Futures report. The data separates U.S. Dollar Index futures positions into Dealer/Intermediary, Asset Manager/Institutional, Leveraged Funds, Other Reportables, and Nonreportables, with long, short, spreading, and net exposure measures where applicable.
indicators.significance: CFTC U.S. Dollar Index futures positioning provides a structured view of market-participant exposure to the U.S. dollar relative to a basket of major foreign currencies. Changes in open interest reveal changes in futures-market participation, while changes in long and short positions show how different trader groups are adjusting dollar exposure. Dollar positioning can provide context for broad USD strength, global foreign-exchange conditions, U.S. monetary-policy expectations, interest-rate differentials, commodity prices, international financial conditions, and global risk sentiment.

indicators.name: Bitcoin Spot ETF Market
indicators.description: A daily measure of U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF market activity, including aggregate net capital flows, traded value, net assets, and cumulative net flows. The indicator provides a view of capital entering or leaving the Bitcoin spot ETF market and the size and activity of the investment vehicles providing regulated market access to Bitcoin.
indicators.significance: Bitcoin spot ETF market data provides a direct view of capital flows and asset levels within regulated investment vehicles that give traditional investors access to Bitcoin. Net flow measures the daily net movement of capital into or out of the ETF market, while value traded measures ETF trading activity. Net assets indicate the aggregate size of assets held through the ETF vehicles, and cumulative net flow tracks the longer-term accumulation of capital flows since the measurement period began. Bitcoin ETF activity can provide important context for institutional and traditional-finance participation in Bitcoin and can be analyzed alongside Bitcoin price, Bitcoin dominance, derivatives positioning, open interest, funding rates, macroeconomic conditions, inflation expectations, interest rates, Treasury yields, liquidity conditions, and broader crypto-market sentiment. ETF flows should be interpreted as activity within the spot Bitcoin ETF market and should not be treated as a complete measure of all institutional Bitcoin ownership or total Bitcoin demand.

indicators.name: WTI Crude Oil
indicators.description: The daily price of West Texas Intermediate crude oil in U.S. dollars per barrel. WTI is a light, sweet crude oil benchmark associated with physical crude traded and delivered at Cushing, Oklahoma.
indicators.significance: WTI is a major crude oil benchmark and an important reference price for U.S. petroleum markets. Its price reflects changing expectations around crude oil supply and demand, U.S. production and inventories, refinery activity, transportation constraints, and global energy conditions. Because oil is a major input into transportation, manufacturing, and other economic activity, WTI movements can also provide signals about inflation and broader economic conditions.

indicators.name: Natural Gas
indicators.description: The daily Henry Hub spot price of natural gas in U.S. dollars per million British thermal units (MMBtu), representing the benchmark price for natural gas delivered at Henry Hub in Louisiana.
indicators.significance: Natural gas is an important U.S. energy commodity used for electricity generation, residential and commercial heating, and industrial processes. Henry Hub prices respond to changes in production, storage, weather, pipeline and infrastructure conditions, and demand from power generation and industry. Natural gas prices therefore provide signals about U.S. energy-market tightness, seasonal conditions, electricity costs, and energy-related inflation.

indicators.name: Brent Crude Oil
indicators.description: The daily price of Brent crude oil quoted in U.S. dollars per barrel. Brent is a major international crude oil benchmark used to represent global oil-market pricing.
indicators.significance: Brent is a major global crude oil benchmark and provides a broad signal of international energy-market conditions. Its price can respond to changes in global oil supply and demand, production disruptions, geopolitical events, trade and transportation conditions, and expectations for economic activity. Brent therefore connects energy markets with inflation, geopolitics, trade, and the broader global economy.

indicators.name: Copper
indicators.description: The monthly global price of copper quoted in U.S. dollars per metric ton, representing the market value of copper across international commodity markets.
indicators.significance: Copper is a widely used industrial metal whose demand is closely connected to manufacturing, construction, electrical infrastructure, power systems, and economic activity. Changes in copper prices can reflect shifts in global industrial demand, infrastructure investment, mine and refinery supply, inventories, and expectations for economic growth. Copper therefore provides a useful cross-market signal for the global industrial cycle and the expansion of electrification and energy infrastructure.

indicators.name: CoinMarketCap Altcoin Season Index
indicators.description: A daily CoinMarketCap index measuring the relative performance of major altcoins versus Bitcoin over a rolling 90-day period. The index uses the top 100 eligible coins ranked on CoinMarketCap, excluding stablecoins and wrapped or asset-backed tokens, and scales the proportion of coins outperforming Bitcoin to a 0-to-100 index.
indicators.significance: The CoinMarketCap Altcoin Season Index measures market breadth by comparing the rolling 90-day performance of the top 100 eligible coins on CoinMarketCap against Bitcoin. Stablecoins and wrapped or asset-backed tokens are excluded from the constituent set. The index reflects the proportion of these coins outperforming Bitcoin and is scaled from 1 to 100. Values above 75 indicate Altcoin Season, while values at or below 25 indicate Bitcoin Season. The index therefore measures the breadth of altcoin outperformance rather than sentiment directly: a high value means a large share of major altcoins have outperformed Bitcoin over the measurement period, while a low value means relatively few have done so. It can be analyzed alongside Bitcoin dominance, altcoin market capitalization, market breadth, liquidity, trading volume, and crypto-market sentiment to provide context for changes in market regime and capital rotation.

Binance positioning can be analyzed alongside Dogecoin price, open interest, funding rates, derivatives activity, Dogecoin network activity, and broader crypto-market conditions to provide additional context for changes in Dogecoin market positioning.

indicators.name: AAII Investor Sentiment Survey
indicators.description: A weekly survey of individual investors measuring the percentage who expect the U.S. stock market to rise, remain essentially unchanged, or fall over the next six months. The dataset includes bullish, neutral, bearish, and bull-bear spread readings.
indicators.significance: The AAII Sentiment Survey provides a direct measure of individual-investor expectations rather than inferring sentiment from market prices or positioning. Changes in bullish, neutral, and bearish responses reveal shifts in optimism, pessimism, and uncertainty, while the bull-bear spread summarizes the balance between optimistic and pessimistic views. Extreme sentiment readings can provide useful context for assessing investor psychology and potential sentiment reversals, but the survey does not establish the future direction of the market.

Changes in open interest reveal changes in participation in the Micro Ether futures market, while changes in long and short positions show how different trader groups are adjusting their Ethereum exposure. Because each contract represents 0.1 ETH, the Micro Ether contract provides a lower-contract-size representation of Ethereum derivatives positioning that complements standard Ether futures data and can provide additional context for crypto market structure, trader positioning, institutional and leveraged activity, and Ethereum derivatives-market conditions.
